SceneOutline: Develop Scene 6 as 3 connected beats, following the story direction.
Outline:
**Purpose:** Caelen attempts to communicate his intent to protect the girl, using gestures and body language to bridge the language barrier while navigating the oppressive atmosphere of the cell.  

**Viewpoint:** Caelen’s internal struggle to understand the girl’s fear and his own role in this new world.  
**Objective:** Establish Caelen’s growing awareness of the system’s brutality and his instinctive desire to shield the girl from harm.  
**Meaningful Change:** Caelen begins to see himself not just as a prisoner but as someone who might challenge the system’s violence, even if only through quiet, unspoken solidarity with the girl.  
**Continuity Dependencies:** The girl’s fear, the overseer’s methodical control, and Caelen’s physical discomfort from the collar and injuries. This beat sets up his internal shift toward empathy and resistance.
